verdict.rationale: smolagents supports long-running, step-by-step agent execution (useful for tool calls that take days) and CLI utilities for running agents without boilerplate, suggesting some support for autonomous multi-step runs, but there is no evidence of scheduling, persistent background daemons, or triggers that let a user set up automations running unattended over time. missing for 10: scheduling/cron-like triggers, persistent background service or daemon mode, documentation of unattended long-running deployment.
